caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware jar with a lid. The jar is light gray in color with subtle shading to highlight its round shape. There are two small handles on opposite sides near the top of the jar. A decorative blue pattern, consisting of curved lines and floral shapes, adorns the area just below the neck of the jar, wrapping around the front. The lid is slightly domed with a knob on top and fits snugly into the wide mouth of the jar. The background is a uniform pale tan, and there are no other objects or additional elements present in the composition.
title: Butter Churn
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
